summary: The cut is clean: the head lowers slowly and steadily with no pops, flicker or camera lurch, though the writing hand and page are out of frame in these tiles.

faults.what: The shot idea is writing on a page, but the hand, pen and page are not visible. Only the forearm edge shows at the bottom, so the action doesn't read in the opening frames.
faults.fix: Reframe or tilt down a little so the writing hand and page are in shot, or cut to an insert of the hand.
